name: Priscilla Harbinger
source:
"Gahahah! Look what the cat dragged in!"

Priscilla is a wild, confident woman who is bored with her job as Manson is at his hospitalization. Because of how competitive they are, they're always getting into bets and fights. Don't underestimate her; She's five feet of fury and knows more than she lets on.

[From [url=https://thugzilla.itch.io/object-ward]Itch.io[/url]]

[Spoiler]Kent's[/spoiler] on/off again girlfriend, though she fails to mention this.
